_comment: Declaration-only emit. The runtime stays raw TypeScript for the bundler (see the
package's `default` export condition and apps/web's transpilePackages), but
consumers resolve TYPES from dist/*.d.ts via the `types` condition.
Why this exists: within a single tsc Program one set of compilerOptions applies to
every file, including transitively-imported .ts. So a consumer importing this
package's raw source re-typechecks the generated runtime under the CONSUMER's
options, and skipLibCheck cannot help because these are .ts, not .d.ts. That
forced apps/web to relax exactOptionalPropertyTypes for its own hand-written code
too — precisely the strictness leak CLAUDE.md's rule exists to prevent.
Emitting .d.ts here moves the boundary back where it belongs: the relaxation stays
in THIS package, and skipLibCheck (inherited, on) exempts the emitted declarations
